source: AI分析(官方答案键+错题包实测数据；仅含错题包与官方解析一致的10题)

class9.knowledgePoint: 听力理解·身份推断（入职场景）

options.cause: 8人选择A——把“领工牌、介绍同事”的入职接待曲解为商务拜访；排除口诀：get your card this afternoon＝人已在办入职手续。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem:
W: Welcome aboard! Your desk is by the window. Let me first introduce you to the team.
Q: What is the relationship between the speakers?
variant.analysis: 张冠李戴——“welcome aboard / introduce to the team”指向入职，不是推销或叙旧。

options.cause: 11人选择B——job applicant（求职者）与 new staff 只差“是否已入职”一步；抓 this afternoon 才发卡，说明手续已办完。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem:
M: I handed in my CV last week, and today they told me I could start on Monday.
Q: What does the man mean?

options.B: He is still waiting for an interview.

variant.analysis: 近义干扰——“start on Monday”说明已录用，别停在 applicant 阶段。

class9.knowledgePoint: 听力理解·说话人观点态度

options.cause: 19人选择A——“有听众来电想听真声”被过度引申为版权/法律纠纷；原文只字未提 legal problems。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem:
W: The app is still in its testing stage, but some users are already selling access to it.
Q: What does the woman imply?

options.A: The app will soon be free.
options.B: Some users are using the app improperly.
options.C: The company will stop the test.

variant.analysis: 无中生有——卖访问权限属违规使用，原文没有“免费”“停产”之意。

options.cause: 4人选择B——300多首AI新歌≠惠及社区；把“任何人可署名使用她的AI声音并分成”偷换成“造福大众”。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem:
M: Our school library opens to villagers every weekend.
Q: What does the man mean?

options.B: The villagers donated money to the school.
options.C: Local people can share the library's resources.

variant.analysis: 偷换概念——开放给村民＝资源共享，不是“村民捐资”。

class9.knowledgePoint: 阅读C篇·研究结论推断（说明文）

options.cause: 39人选择D——研究警示的是 isoprene 与尾气氮氧化物反应生成臭氧、伤及呼吸，并非“吸碳不如预期”；原文明确肯定树木 absorb carbon 的好处。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem:
A new study finds that e-scooters cut car trips only slightly, while producing piles of extra battery waste.
Q: What does the study imply about e-scooters?

options.B: Their green label may be misleading.
options.C: Their batteries last shorter than expected.

variant.analysis: 偷换概念——“额外电池垃圾”≠“电池不耐用”，可续写句：the green label may be misleading。

options.cause: 1人选择B——“影响其他树生长”在原文无据，系把 provide wildlife habitat 的相邻表述拼凑成答案。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem:
The report says city foxes dig under garden fences at night.
Q: What does the report say about foxes?
variant.analysis: 无中生有——“攻击宠物”“传染疾病”均为拼凑，原文只讲挖洞进园。

class9.knowledgePoint: 完形填空·抽象名词辨析（首句顿悟）

options.cause: 13人选择B——把“幻象”的语感当答案；fantasy 不与 of + 事实性内容搭配，the realization of“意识到……”才接“别人对俄亥俄了解甚少”。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: The moment I unpacked, I _____ that dorm life was nothing like home.
variant.analysis: 近义干扰——realize 接事实从句；fantasize 表“空想”，与“顿悟”相反。

options.cause: 7人选择A——expectation 是动身前的“期待”，本句讲“到校后很快发生”的顿悟，时间与心态都对不上。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: _____ to see the world, she packed her bags the day after graduation.
variant.analysis: 张冠李戴——“期待”是他人视角的词，主动决心用 determined。

options.cause: 17人选择C——still 表“仍然”不置于数词前；本句强调“只有三个半小时”不算远，与下文同学的夸张提问形成反差，只能用 only。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: _____ ten students signed up, so the trip was called off.
variant.analysis: 副词修饰数词表“仅仅”用 only；still/even/already 无此用法。

options.cause: 9人选择D——even 表递进“甚至”，此处没有递进对象，只有“距离其实很近”的限缩语气。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: He speaks three foreign languages, and he is _____ learning a fourth.
variant.analysis: 递进补充用 even；only 表限缩，与“还在学第四门”的递进语境相反。

class9.knowledgePoint: 完形填空·形容词辨析与搭配（thankful for）

options.cause: 27人选择C——suitable for 搭配成立但语义不通；“越长大越____故乡情结”是情感词位，下文 grateful 同向印证 thankful。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: She is deeply _____ to her teachers for their support.
variant.analysis: thankful to sb for sth 固定搭配；suitable/reliable 不进入该句型。

options.cause: 2人选择D——reliable（可靠的）修饰人或物，不能说“我对根可靠”；注意与 relying 拼写邻近的干扰。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: We need a _____ witness whose account can be trusted.
variant.analysis: 可靠证人＝reliable；thankful/grateful 表感谢，语义不合。

class9.knowledgePoint: 完形填空·动词辨析与搭配（complain about）

options.cause: 25人选择B——lie about how bored（撒谎说无聊）与 loved to（爱做的事）语义拧；两个少年好友爱干的事是“互相吐槽”。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: Teenagers often _____ to their parents about too much homework.
variant.analysis: complain to sb about sth 固定搭配；lie about 表撒谎，不合语境。

options.cause: 13人选择A——hear about（听说）是信息接收方用的词；主人公吐槽自己的生活，输出端用 complain about。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: I _____ about the traffic jam from my colleague, so I left home earlier.
variant.analysis: hear about＝听说（输入信息）；complain about＝抱怨（输出情绪）。

class9.knowledgePoint: 完形填空·逻辑连接词（转折）

options.cause: 21人选择A——分号前“抱怨无聊”与后“深爱小镇”构成转折；therefore（因此）把逻辑方向接反。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: The hike was exhausting; _____, every one of us reached the top with a big smile.
variant.analysis: 前抑后扬用 however；therefore 表因果，与“累却开心”的转折相反。

options.cause: 6人选择D——otherwise 表“否则”，需引出相反后果的虚拟语义；此处只是语篇转折。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: Leave now; _____, you will miss the last bus.
variant.analysis: otherwise＝“否则”引出反向后果，此语境专属。

class9.knowledgePoint: 完形填空·名词辨析（语境照应）

options.cause: 24人选择C——procedure（程序）指办事流程，不与 centers around being outside 搭配；pace of life / connecting to neighbors 都指向“生活方式”。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: In this company, every _____ follows the same steps: apply, interview, train.
variant.analysis: 申请-面试-培训是流程＝procedure；lifestyle 指生活方式。

options.cause: 19人选择D——personality（性格）是个体心理特质，无法被“围绕户外活动”组织起来。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: Jogging before breakfast is part of his healthy _____.
variant.analysis: 晨跑习惯＝lifestyle；personality 指性格特征。

class9.knowledgePoint: 完形填空·动词搭配（trust … to do）

options.cause: 10人选择D——challenge … to lead（挑战根的引领？）与结尾感恩信赖的基调相反；trust A to B＝相信A会B。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: Rather than _____ the new guide, the team followed his route with full confidence.
variant.analysis: with full confidence 与 challenge 语义冲突；信赖跟随用 trust。

options.cause: 8人选择C——remind 不接“sb to lead me”表“提醒引路”，句法与语义双重生硬；trust my roots to lead me＝相信根会引我前行。（全班作答 58 人）

variant.stem: Please _____ me to call grandma tonight—I always forget.
variant.analysis: remind sb to do 固定搭配；“相信某人会做”才用 trust sb to do。
